name: Vigorous Spellwork
body:
You can convert some of a spell’s energy into a minor restorative.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 1 ranks, Heal 1 rank, ability to cast 1st level spells.

Benefit: Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher you heal a number of hit points equal to the level of the spell.
